pages.text: Prepare farmland before selecting Farm. Registration is a snapshot, not a scan that expands with every later field. Reissue Farm to include new plots. Supply seeds, carrots, potatoes, or other suitable planting stock.

The farmer harvests mature crops and replants the same crop from its bag. Registered soil can be tilled back after reverting to supported dirt. Air, stone, or other non-soil removes a plot until Farm is selected again.
A missing hoe, seed shortage, blocked planting, exhaustion, or full cargo needs attention. Releasing at another block clears old plot registration and waits for a new Farm order.
